messages:
raj: heads up — onboarding sampleapp stream keeps going silent after ~30s, client shows no reconnect.
ellie: reproable on my laptop too? which sdk/sampleapp?
raj: node sampleapp using eventsource-polyfill (we used the quickstart). Happens on Chrome and an internal runner. No errors in console, just no messages. :thinking_face:
samir: could be heartbeat/keepalive mismatch with our proxy auth refresh. did you see any 401s upstream?
raj: nothing obvious. here's the tail of the local runner logs around the moment it drops:
raj: ```
[2026-03-17T21:03:12Z] stream: send keepalive
[2026-03-17T21:03:42Z] auth: refresh token start
[2026-03-17T21:03:42Z] proxy: 101 switching protocols
[2026-03-17T21:03:42Z] stream: client received blank chunk (\n\n)
[2026-03-17T21:03:42Z] auth: refresh token done
[2026-03-17T21:03:45Z] stream: no data for 10s, client still open
[2026-03-17T21:03:50Z] stream: client shows open but no events delivered
```
ellie: hmm blank chunk as in empty line(s) — our SSE parser treats lone CRLF as keepalive. But if auth refresh pauses the socket at the proxy layer we sometimes reassemble incorrectly and swallow the next data event.
raj: how would that manifest to the app? it looks like the connection didn't trigger close, so the client never attempts reconnect.
samir: exactly. if an auth refresh causes an intermediate TCP-level delay + proxy that re-sends a keepalive comment ":\n" in the gap, some client libs merge that with the next data chunk and our last-event-id handling gets clobbered. Quick fix: detect long gap and force a reconnect from client side.
ellie: can you paste the client-side EventSource snippet? maybe we need a simple watchdog.
raj: sample is basically:
raj: ```js
const es = new EventSource(url);
es.onmessage = (e) => console.log('msg', e.data);
es.onopen = () => console.log('open');
es.onerror = () => console.log('err');
```
raj: no reconnection hook beyond default.
samir: add a small watchdog that checks last message timestamp and calls es.close()+new EventSource(url) after 2x expected keepalive period. Should be 1-2 lines in sampleapp.
ellie: agree. Also we should update sampleapp README to call out an auth-refresh edge: "If you see silent stalls, enable the WATCHDOG=true env var or bump keepalive interval." I'll draft a tiny patch.
raj: would it be worth changing server behavior? e.g., ensure any token refresh path emits a comment `:auth-refresh\n` so clients see activity.
samir: that's a good signal but fragile. I'd prefer server emit an explicit SSE comment when it pauses: `:pause start` / `:pause end` to make reassembly visible.
devex-bot: @samir created a PR draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sampleapps/pull/512 — adds watchdog + README note. :rocket:
ellie: amazing. can someone also add a note in devex docs about client libs that collapse '\n\n' vs keepalive? might save folks time.
raj: thanks — adding a small repro script and logs to the PR. If this helps others, we should include a tiny test in CI that simulates a delayed chunk during auth refresh and asserts client reconnects.
samir: yes, add a flaky-tolerant test using netcat to splice chunks. I'll add it to the PR.
ellie: ok i'm merging the README + watchdog patch after CI. closing the onboarding ticket once deployed to staging. :white_check_mark:
raj: thanks all, saved my onboarding call earlier.
